For batch 18, the time to reach 45 °C is predicted by the best held‑out model (exponential, §3a) as  

\[
t_{\text{to }45\text{°C}}(18) = 32.7764 + 10\,410.9\bigl(e^{8.17026\times10^{-6}\,\cdot\,18}-1\bigr) \approx 34.31\ \text{min}.
\]

The median normalized cooling shape (§4) gives the fraction of the total observed span when the temperature crosses 45 °C:  
\(x_{45} \approx 0.6125\) (linear interpolation between \(x=0.600,\ 45.45\text{°C}\) and \(x=0.625,\ 44.55\text{°C}\)).  

Thus the effective span for batch 18 is  
\[
\text{span} = \frac{34.31\ \text{min}}{0.6125} \approx 56.01\ \text{min},
\]  
and the fraction corresponding to \(t = 7.9\ \text{min}\) is  
\[
x = \frac{7.9}{56.01} \approx 0.1411.
\]

Interpolating the shape table at \(x = 0.1411\) (between \(x=0.125\): 73.00 °C and \(x=0.150\): 70.88 °C) gives  

\[
T_c \approx 73.00 + (0.1411 - 0.125)\frac{70.88 - 73.00}{0.025} \approx 71.64\ \text{°C}.
\]

FINAL ESTIMATE: 71.6 °C
